name: Albescent-Maw
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a nearby asteroid belt, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Regular pulses leave the monolithic structures of unknown origin aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
